# OmniPhysicsDeformablePoseAPI (bind pose)

Named point sets of a deformable body's meshes, applied as OmniPhysicsDeformablePoseAPI:<name> with an arbitrary instance name. The walkers pick the instance whose purposes name bindPose as the bind pose of the simulation, collision, skin and cooking-source meshes, and each mesh's own points serve without one; see the notes for the purposes name the walkers actually read.

- **Applies to:** [`PointBased`](glossary.md#pointbased)
- **Multi-apply:** applied as `OmniPhysicsDeformablePoseAPI:<instance>`; `<inst>` in a column name is the instance. Instances: any instance name.
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## Columns

*Raw fallback* is the [USD](glossary.md#usd) schema value. *Producer writes* is what [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) population puts in the column for a USD stage. *Parser default* applies on the consumer when the column is absent, in stage units. **diverges** means writing the raw fallback literally parses differently from omitting the column (the parser default): USD population may well publish that very value for an unauthored attribute, so the marker is about the column being present, not about its value.

| Column | Type | Units | Raw fallback | Producer writes | Parser default | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deformablePose:<inst>:omniphysics:points` | float32[3] array, POINT | length |  | not written |  | Read only for the instance the walker chose as bind pose. Without the column the simulation mesh's bind points fall back to its points (as for any length mismatch), a skin mesh contributes no bind points, and volume cooking with a separate collision mesh fails ('Cooking failed'). |
| `deformablePose:<inst>:omniphysics:purposes` | uint64 array, TOKEN_ID | none |  | not written |  | Not read when parsing: both walkers look for the bindPose purpose under omniphysics:<inst>:purposes instead (see notes), so this column, absent or present, selects no bind pose. The runtime only watches it for changes (re-cook check, re-parse of a registered bind-pose instance). |

## Notes

- Instance names are arbitrary, so no instances are declared.
- Reader mismatch: both walkers read omniphysics:<inst>:purposes (the ovstage walker as one scalar token, the USD walker as a token array), not the schema property deformablePose:<inst>:omniphysics:purposes. On a schema-conformant stage no bind-pose instance is found, so every mesh uses its own points as bind pose and deformablePose:<inst>:omniphysics:points is never read.
